headOutput.originalFieldMeaning: The original HEAD responseBodySha256 hashes curl --head output, which contains response headers; it is not a received entity-body hash.

requestLimit: Three configured curl invocations, retry zero and no redirect following; physical wire-attempt count is not independently measured.
rootStatus: HTTP 400 is retained and is not an application-health claim.
privacy: Response cookie values remain private and were never sent back; public summary contains only selected safe headers and hashes.
qualification: Anonymous TLS/H2/CORS metadata only; X-Dry-Run is advertised but untested, no object/certificate/account/deployment or paid effect
